column1: # Game profile of Crash Bandicoot N. Sane Trilogy (Switch, base game 1.0.0). On Android it plays at 30 fps (as on the Switch) from a new game through Crash 1's opening
# cinematic into N. Sanity Beach (a Galaxy Z Fold 8's cover screen, see README.md); the Mac has run it to the title screen
# Vicarious Visions' Alchemy engine (Havok, FMOD), NVN, SDK 3.5.3; modules main + subsdk0 (GLSLC, NVN's runtime shader compiler) + sdk. The provisional profile
# the survey made (dm/games/profile_guess.py), unchanged but for these comments and the shader groups. Every RomFS file is in archives/*.pak, Alchemy IGA archives of LZMA pieces;
# the shaders are whole GLSLC outputs in the .igz files of archives/shaders_nx.pak (shader_split.py through iga.py), and the two Bink movie shaders the game compiles at boot
